_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Glance
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Glance is a self-hosted start page that puts feeds, calendars, bookmarks and status widgets on one dashboard. The egg serves it on the server's port behind a login you set; edit glance.yml to build your page.
startup: if [ -z "${GLANCE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && grep -q 'GLANCE_PASSWORD}' glance.yml; then echo "Set Login password in the server's settings, or remove the auth block from glance.yml, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; exec ./glance -config glance.yml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Glance: downloads Glance from its GitHub releases, checked against
# GitHub's SHA-256, and writes a first glance.yml with a login. glance.yml
# and anything it includes are never touched once there.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Glance has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag glanceapp/glance "$version") ||
    fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.8.8, then reinstall."
if [ -x glance ] && [ "$(cat .glance-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Glance $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Glance $tag."
    gh-release download glanceapp/glance "$tag" "glance-linux-$arch.tar.gz" "$work/glance.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/glance.tar.gz" -C "$work" glance
    install -m 0755 "$work/glance" glance.new
    mv -f glance.new glance
    echo "$tag" > .glance-version
fi

if [ ! -f glance.yml ]; then
    secret=$(./glance secret:make)
    cat > glance.yml <<YAML
# Glance's settings: https://github.com/glanceapp/glance/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
# Glance reloads this file when it changes. \${...} are the server's settings.
server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: \${SERVER_PORT}

# Visitors sign in with the server's Login name and Login password. Remove
# this block to make the dashboard public.
auth:
  secret-key: $secret
  users:
    \${GLANCE_USERNAME}:
      password: \${GLANCE_PASSWORD}

pages:
  - name: Home
    columns:
      - size: small
        widgets:
          - type: calendar
            first-day-of-week: monday
          - type: clock
            hour-format: 24h

      - size: full
        widgets:
          - type: search
            search-engine: duckduckgo
          - type: hacker-news
          - type: rss
            limit: 10
            collapse-after: 5
            cache: 12h
            feeds:
              - url: https://selfh.st/rss/
                title: selfh.st
YAML
fi
echo "Installed Glance $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Glance version to install, such as 0.8.8, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Login name
variables.description: The name visitors sign in with.

variables.name: Login password
variables.description: The password visitors sign in with, at least 8 characters.
